entities.summary: Rachid Hammami, best known as Brother Rachid, also Brother Rasheed, is a Moroccan former Muslim and convert to Christianity whose father is an Imam. He is a Christian apologist and critic of Islam, and hosts a weekly live call-in show on Al Hayat TV where he compares Islam and Christianity.
